dose_limits.note: Standard adult dose 250-500 mg three times daily. High-dose 3 g/day for certain indications.
Standard starting dose 5 mg once daily; maximum 10 mg once daily.
Usual dose 10-80 mg once daily. Maximum 80 mg/day.
For hypertension: usual 10-40 mg once daily. Heart failure: up to 35 mg/day.
Heart failure: 25-50 mg/day. Higher doses used in primary aldosteronism.
Oedema: 20-80 mg daily. Up to 600 mg/day in resistant cases under close supervision.
